Paragraphe · Polyphenols are the antioxidant compound
blocks_element.text: Polyphenols are the antioxidant compounds that researchers have associated with heart health, brain function, and reduced inflammation. Most olive oils lose them during production and over time. Ours are preserved because we harvest early, cold-press without heat, never blend with other oils, and ship from our most recent harvest, the 2025-2026 harvest (October 2025).

blocks_element.text: Most olive oil on store shelves was harvested 18+ months ago. Ours was harvested in October 2025. Single estate means every bottle comes from our one farm in Spain, not a blend of oils from multiple anonymous sources.
